name: Email Verification Code Rejected
summary: The user submits verification proof that cannot be accepted, email ownership remains unverified, and the same code-entry view renders in the code-rejected presentation state.

preconditions.expression: durable identity is unverified and a verification challenge exists

inputs.name: Verification Code
inputs.description: Mismatched six-digit proof used for the canonical rejected scenario; expired, consumed, and exhausted proof remain test permutations of the same public rejection.

serverInteraction.intent: Reject unacceptable verification proof without verifying email ownership or exposing the internal rejection reason.

postconditions.expression: email remains unconfirmed and the user remains on code entry with a rejected presentation result

sourceReferences.note: Rejected proof remains on the same simple code-entry screen and uses View State for deterministic rendering and runtime verification.
